**Implementation note:** Volatility scaling exists for the grid, not for factor portfolios.

## Description

Scales factor exposure up or down inversely to forecast factor volatility or a volatility state, aiming to preserve risk budget through turbulent periods.

## Where it may fit

Time-varying factor volatility and crash-prone momentum exposures; may help but can de-risk after a selloff too late.

## Vehicles

Equity factor, long-short quant and multi-factor portfolios.

## Required data

Factor returns, rolling or forecast volatility, factor exposure, market liquidity, prices and transaction costs.

## Caveats

Scaling reduces exposure rather than predicting direction; volatility spikes may be backward-looking and lower notional can miss rebounds.
